title: First Olympic Games, traditionally dated 776 BCE
summary: Greek city-states held athletic games at Olympia every four years in honour of Zeus, traditionally from 776 BCE; the four-year Olympiad became a unit of time.
why: Ancestor of the modern Olympics and an early shared calendar for the Greek world.

notes.problem: 776 BCE is a traditional date: source says 'traditionally dated to 776 BC' and Aristotle's date was accepted 'by most, though not all' ancient historians.
